name: skills-hub
description: Personal curated skill hub: own skills plus vendored, reviewed upstream skills. Single marketplace consumed by all GeorgeBoxs project repos.

metadata.description: 44 skills in 6 domain plugins. Versions intentionally omitted so consumers auto-update by git SHA on every merged commit.

plugins.name: george-core
plugins.description: Own skills: ship-gate (pre-production audit), agent-harness (bounded agentic loops), handoff (session handoff docs), landing (self-contained HTML landing pages), market-research (TAM/SAM/SOM methodology).

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design and UX: epic-design (cinematic scroll/motion), brand-guidelines, ui-design-system, ux-researcher-designer, apple-hig-expert, a11y-audit (WCAG 2.2 AA), senior-frontend.

plugins.name: landing-cro
plugins.description: Landing pages and conversion: landing-page-generator (Next.js TSX), page-cro, onboarding-cro, copywriting, marketing-psychology.

plugins.name: product
